note: How far a sample record has got (sample.status). Our wording. Proposals awaiting review.

terms.label: demo
terms.definition: Generated for the demo. Not a real sample; every value is made up.

terms.label: draft
terms.definition: A real sample, record still being filled in.

terms.label: reviewed
terms.definition: A real sample, record checked by a second person.

terms.label: final
terms.definition: Complete and checked. Its tag may be locked.
